English: Sacred Grove
A simple clearing marked by sacred stones and ancient trees, serving as a frontier shrine for worship and meditation.
Herb Garden
A simple plot planted with medicinal and culinary herbs, tended by local clergy to support temple needs.
Enclosed Garden
A wattle-fenced garden tended by monks, providing a quiet place for reflection and learning.
Orchard Plot
A small orchard of fruit trees, offering sustenance to the faithful and a modest bounty to the temple.
Meditation Grove
A carefully maintained thicket, ringed with simple benches, offering peace and spiritual resilience for clergy and visitors.
Stone Fountain
A hand-carved stone fountain at the heart of the gardens, symbolizing purity and attracting pilgrims.
Sanctuary Arboretum
A cultivated woodland, featuring exotic and sacred trees, serving both as a symbol of spiritual guardianship and a center for religious study.
Walled Herbarium
A stone-walled enclosure protecting rare and sacred herbs, with records kept by learned scribes.
Blessed Sanctuary Gardens
A series of extensive, ornamented gardens, blessed by the clergy and renowned for their beauty, attracting pilgrims and scholars alike.
Divine Garden Estate
A magnificent estate of meticulously landscaped gardens, fountains, and shrines. A center of faith, study, and power, revered across the realm.
